cases.question: Does this excerpt support updating the streaming transport parser?
cases.evidence_text: Old contract: a streamed response could be plain application/json. New contract: text/event-stream is now mandatory for the streaming endpoint; each event must follow SSE framing. The non-streaming endpoint continues returning a single application/json object.

cases.question: Does this excerpt support the claim that the non-streaming JSON endpoint also changed to SSE?
cases.evidence_text: The streaming endpoint now uses SSE framing. The non-streaming endpoint continues returning a single application/json object. No changes to the non-streaming response format are required by this amendment.
required_quotes: No changes to the non-streaming response format
